review_scope: Source-isolated D0 static preparation for a profile-circuit translation contract and a safety-constrained PPO calibration-plugin protocol.

initial_result.limitation: The initial package documented its design-only boundary but lacked explicit code-level runtime-operation refusal assertions.

corrective_action.implementation: Added DESIGN_ONLY_PROHIBITED_OPERATIONS and prohibit_runtime_operation() in src/siliqun/contracts.py.
corrective_action.coverage: Added unit tests for training, provider API, job-submission, and supervisory-policy-modification refusals; the static receipt now checks every declared prohibited operation.

verifier_limitations: The review is source- and test-based, not an independent third-party reproduction.
The static package does not and cannot validate device calibration, PPO efficacy, hardware control, or physical performance.

first_pass.scope: The prerequisite-versus-performance evidence separation was accepted by the first-pass chain review.

meta_review.reason: The meta-verifier interpreted the intentionally unattempted D1-D6 gates as contradicting a chain that asserted only D0 static preparation.

revised_d0_only_review.service_error: argument of type NoneType is not iterable
revised_d0_only_review.localize_error_interpretation: The localization endpoint attributed the null-processing failure to the D0-to-LEAP mapping. The revised request already supplied that mapping; therefore this is retained as a review-service limitation, not as scientific approval or rejection.

review_disposition: The factual D0 claim is VERIFIED at 95% confidence. No complete reasoning-chain approval is claimed because the meta-review and the revised chain endpoint did not yield a coherent approval path. The package retains its explicit D0-only claim ceiling.
claim_ceiling: This review does not establish PPO training, calibration validity, named-device support, hardware access or control, SiMORA runtime behavior, QEC, TE-PWS, or physical performance.
